scenes.summary: Nongye Tianshi Tian Min informs you that due to seed loss and insufficient manpower, the planting plan in the Agricultural Test Site is on the verge of collapse. He requests your assistance in cultivating some crops.

lines.text: We're completely understaffed... There's no way we'll make it in time...
Yeah. I'm in charge of this Agricultural Test Site... Can I help you?
Wait, that outfit... I think I've seen it before. Ah! Don't tell me you're the help Ms. Fiona mentioned, the Endministrator?
Excellent! Now we might actually make it!
Oh right, before I forget. We were planning to grow a batch of ⟦key|Amber Rice⟧ in the test fields for specialized research.
But during transport, over half our seeds were lost to the Blight Tide.
Right now, the Nongye Tianshi are critically short-handed. Our plan is on the verge of collapse...
Yes, right here on these test fields. If you're willing to help, you could ask that botanist over there. He has plenty of seeds.
Yeah, that's ⟦key|Wellmorin⟧ over there. He seems to have come from Valley IV and brought all sorts of seeds.
Though he's a little ... particular. Last time, he'd only sell me a handful.
We'll leave it to you then, Endmin.
This is our Amber Rice. If you've got machines for seed-picking, feel free to harvest some seeds.

options: So you want me to help with the crops?

lines.text: We can finally catch a breath. Now we just need to keep collecting crop samples and push forward with the research.
Hah! What a haul. My seed vault's about to get a lot more diverse.
Oh? It's you!
Hold on, let me finish collecting these seeds from the Burdo-Muck... They're valuable samples.
Good, that should just about do it... So, you're here to buy seeds again?
Of course! I've gathered plenty of new seeds along the way!
Didn't expect Landbreakers here. But since we ran into them, might as well take a little something from them, right?
Ahem, enough about that. You're here for seeds, right? Take a look yourself.
Same as always. Fixed price, no haggling!

options: Yeah. You got any Amber Rice seeds?

lines.text: What's up? Here for more seeds?
Alright, you're a regular by now. Go ahead and look. Everything here was hard to collect this time.
Rules haven't changed alright. Still fixed prices, no bargaining!
Burdo-Muck? Didn't expect you to be interested in that...
Just so you know, this "intel" took some effort to dig up. But since you're a regular, I won't charge extra.
This Burdo-Muck is the real deal. Not only are the seeds inside more vibrant, but the waste itself makes excellent fertilizer.
Go ahead and try it later if you don't believe me. Guaranteed to work.
Won't keep you then. I've got more seeds to collect!

options: Let's see what seeds you have in stock.
I actually wanted to ask about the Burdo-Muck...

scenes.summary: After successfully planting the crops in the Agricultural Test Site, you report the progress to Tian Min. Delighted yet concerned, he mentions the crop's high water demands. You decide to resolve the issue using the Sprinkler from Endfield.

lines.text: Endmin, have you finished planting all the crops?
Excellent! No wonder you're the Endministrator!
I see. Then I've definitely come to the right person!
Speaking of which, these crops need a lot of water, so they require constant hydration. Normally, this kind of work can be quite exhausting.
⟦key|Sprinklers⟧? I think I've heard of those... They're supposed to be flexible and convenient. They could definitely work for irrigating the test fields.
Endmin, you should give it a try later.
I wonder if Endfield has any solutions for this...

options: I've had some prior experience with cultivation.
Perhaps we could try our ⟦key|Sprinkler⟧ out.

lines.text: Let's hope everything goes smoothly. Or I wouldn't know what to do about our crop research.
With the Endmin's help, this research project might actually stay on track.
